verdict: Same defect class as F-04/ref_nakshatra_get, but with stronger evidence: not only does the live, fully-populated (20 rows) brahma_dasha_systems table exist with exactly the fields ref_dasha_systems_get's description promises (verified correct for Vimshottari: 7+20+6+10+7+18+16+19+17=120 years, matching classical values exactly) — a complete, correct, already-registered-and-tested capability (query_dasha_systems) that queries this exact table already exists in the codebase. ref_dasha_systems_get's handler (register_p1_reference.ts:369-408) simply calls the wrong capability URI (query_classical_texts) instead of the right one (query_dasha_systems), producing topically-irrelevant classical-text search hits (Muhurta Chintamani marriage-timing dosha verses) in place of correct structured Vimshottari/Yogini/Ashtottari/Jaimini sequence data that was one URI-string away from being wired correctly.
